department: Department of Statistics and Data Sciences

deadline.value: The department's admissions page says all materials are due December 1 (2026 for Fall 2027); the Graduate School's program list says December 15. Apply by December 1 to be safe. Fall entry only.
deadline.quote: Applications to the Ph.D. in Statistics program are due by December 1. Newly admitted students enter the program in the fall only.

gre_general.value: The GRE General test is required for Fall 2027 admission.
gre_general.quote: The GRE will be required for Fall 2027 admissions.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Admission is decided by the program's faculty admissions committee; students work with several faculty before choosing an advisor.
supervisor.quote: Admissions to the Ph.D. in Statistics program is overseen by the Admissions Committee that is composed of experienced faculty members

funding.value: All admitted PhD students are guaranteed five years of support through teaching or research assistantships (tuition plus stipend), subject to satisfactory progress.
funding.quote: Some students are able to finish the program in four years, but all admitted students are guaranteed five years of financial support.

also.quote: Financial support will consist of an assistantship with either teaching or research duties.

entry_route.value: Apply with a master's in statistics/biostatistics or a bachelor's in mathematics, statistics or a closely related field, with calculus-based probability and introductory statistics.
entry_route.quote: An earned master’s degree in Applied Statistics, Mathematical Statistics, Biostatistics, or an equivalent to any of these from an accredited college or university OR | An earned bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, or a course of study that satisfactorily covers many of the key subjects in these degrees

notes: Average GPA of recent admits is 3.80/4.0; a Mathematics Preparation Form is required.
